props.text: View detailed specifications before you compare trailers.

When you're running a business that relies on every mile, every load, and every delivery, your trailer choice isn't just about price; it's about performance. Hyundai Translead trailers are known across the industry for their smart engineering, long-haul durability, and innovative features that make life on the road easier. Whether you're hauling freight across Florida or across the country, these trailers offer the kind of reliability that hardworking carriers depend on. Let's take a closer look at what makes Hyundai Translead a top choice for fleets and owner-operators, and how Sun State Trailers helps keep your business moving forward.
There's a reason Hyundai Translead is one of the fastest-growing trailer manufacturers in North America. Their trailers are engineered for strength, fuel efficiency, and maximum uptime.

items.title: Stronger Builds for Tougher Loads
items.intro: Premium components like composite side panels, galvanized steel rear frames, and high-tensile floors hold up under pressure. Many models feature a one-piece aluminum roof for added leak protection, while corrosion-resistant materials extend trailer lifespan in humid, coastal regions like Florida.

items.title: Fuel-Saving Aerodynamics
items.intro: Aerodynamic features reduce drag and improve MPG. Optional side skirts and nose fairings can be added to maximize efficiency, especially for long-haul routes. Over time, these small design choices can mean big savings.

items.title: Lighter Weight, Higher Payload
items.intro: With advanced material blends, Hyundai Translead trailers often weigh less than comparable brands, allowing you to haul more without compromising DOT compliance. Less deadweight means higher margins and better ROI on every load.

props.text: A Partner Who Understands Your Business

When you choose Sun State Trailers, you're not dealing with a faceless vendor. You're working with a local team that values your time, respects your business, and makes the process straightforward from day one.

items.title: Built-in Support and Custom Options
items.intro: Need a specific configuration? Looking for trailer availability without the long factory lead times? Our team is here to help you order exactly what you need or get you on the road quickly with in-stock inventory.

items.title: Local Financing That Works for You
items.intro: Whether you're looking to purchase, lease, or rent, we'll help you explore the best payment structure for your goals while keeping your cash flow intact.

items.title: Service That Keeps You Running
items.intro: From preventive maintenance to urgent repairs, our trailer service and repair teams help keep downtime to a minimum, built around your schedule.

props.text: Choosing the Right Hyundai Translead Trailer Model

From dry vans to reefers, Hyundai Translead offers a range of trailer options. The right one for you depends on what and where you haul. Need help narrowing it down? Our sales team is here to walk you through available trailer models and help you compare your options.
What You Should Look for in a Hyundai Translead Trailer
Hyundai trailers are built to go the distance, but knowing what to prioritize when making your investment matters just as much.

items.text: Look for longevity, not just price — a Hyundai Translead trailer might cost more upfront than some competitors, but its low maintenance requirements and long service life make it a smart long-term investment.

Choose specs that match your routes — weight, length, and insulation options should match your most common hauls. If you're running cold storage loads or produce, don't settle for a general dry van. Let our team help you spec it right the first time.

Don't overlook dealer support — buying the trailer is only step one. At Sun State Trailers, we've got a dedicated support team and locations across Florida to help you get what you need fast; no runaround, no red tape.

props.text: Whether you're looking to upgrade your current fleet or purchase your first trailer, Hyundai Translead is a brand you can count on, and Sun State Trailers is the team that stands behind it. Let us help you spec, finance, and maintain a trailer that's truly built for your business.
